svg.title: Bicubic Bézier patch control grid and connected indexed triangle sampling
svg.desc: A tensor-product bicubic Bézier patch with sixteen world-space control points defines a raised garden canopy. The 6x6 parametric grid contains 49 shared indexed positions, 72 triangular faces, 120 unique edges, 24 boundary edges and Euler characteristic one. Control polygon and evaluated grid are distinct. The oblique diagram uses a parallel projection, not a camera model.
svg.text: Sixteen controls shape an entire two-parameter surface
The grid has shared indexed vertices. The 3D scene is drawn with an explicit parallel oblique map.
The mathematical patch is smooth. Its finite mesh is an approximation with explicit shared topology and parameter-space resolution.
